---
type: note
title: Honey Badger Defense
description: mustelid hive raiding and aposematic coloration
tags: [wildlife, africa]
---

The honey badger is a squat mustelid famous for fearless hive raiding. Its
thick loose skin and aposematic black-and-white coloration warn predators
away from the burrows it digs with long foreclaws. See [Savanna](savanna.md).
